source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: SVT may have wide QRS with bundle block or intraventricular aberrancy.
invariants: Same overlapping retrograde P as narrow SVT
Shared RBBB QRS and secondary ST/T with shorter support
Same SVT event grid and fixed perfusion inputs; non-ECG channels unchanged
Atomic orphan/conflicting configuration rejection and wire recovery
limitations: Not rate-dependent aberrancy or reentry mechanism
Not calibrated pump impairment or clinical waveform measurements
No episode onset/termination or AVNRT/AVRT differentiation
